import subprocess, pathlib, time

# 1. Save this command ID to processed file BEFORE killing ourselves
#    (prevents re-execution by new agent)
proc_f = pathlib.Path('C:/cits/repo/cits/logs/.processed_commands')
proc_f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
existing = set()
if proc_f.exists():
    existing = set(x for x in proc_f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip().split('\n') if x)
existing.add('safe_restart_20260413_1950')
proc_f.write_text('\n'.join(sorted(existing)), encoding='utf-8')
print('PROCESSED_SAVED:', len(existing), 'ids')

# 2. git pull to get latest code onto disk
r = subprocess.run(
    ['git', 'pull', 'origin', 'claude/continue-kabusute-DmFKB', '--quiet'],
    cwd='C:/cits/repo', capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
print('GIT_PULL rc=' + str(r.returncode))
if r.returncode != 0:
    print('GIT_ERR:', r.stderr[:200])

# 3. Read current agent PID
pid_f = pathlib.Path('C:/cits/vps_agent.pid')
old_pid = pid_f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() if pid_f.exists() else ''
print('OLD_PID:', old_pid)

# 4. Delete PID file so new agent can claim singleton
pid_f.unlink(missing_ok=True)

# 5. Start new agent BEFORE killing old (subprocess continues after parent dies)
subprocess.Popen(['C:/cits/venv/Scripts/pythonw.exe', '-m', 'cits.scripts.vps_agent'])
print('NEW_AGENT_STARTED')
time.sleep(2)

# 6. Kill old agent (ourselves) — this python.exe subprocess survives
if old_pid:
    subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/f', '/pid', old_pid], capture_output=True)
    print('KILLED:', old_pid)
print('DONE')
